name: Bonchon Chicken
notes: Chain location; work-list address is 4690 Convoy Street #102, San Diego. DoorDash's own address FAQ for this store listing says '4690 Convoy St #120, San Diego, CA 92111, USA' (Bonchon's own restaurants.bonchon.com location page also uses 'suite-102' in its URL slug) -- same street address/building, minor suite-number discrepancy between sources, treated as the same location rather than a different branch. This restaurant's own Olo storefront (order.bonchon.com, serve-next.olo.com) is a fully static-exported Next.js app with zero server-rendered data -- all menu data is fetched client-side after JS runs, so it could not be read without a browser. DoorDash's server-rendered schema.org Menu JSON-LD was used instead (tier 3, medium at best). No second priced source was reachable to cross-check (bonchon.com/menu is a marketing page with no prices). Several items (chicken by cut: Drums/Strips/Wings/Mixed/Boneless, Dipping Sauce, Fried Rice, Potstickers) show a '+' base price because they are modifier-driven (pick a count/size); the price recorded is DoorDash's own listed starting price for the cheapest required option, noted as 'from' in the description. Dropped the 'Most Ordered' carousel entirely -- all 12 of its items are exact-name duplicates of items already captured in their real categories. Categories reached: NEW ITEMS, KOREAN FRIED CHICKEN, APPETIZERS, KOREAN DISHES, SIDES, DESSERTS, K-MEALS, DRINKS (8 real sections, 57 items after dedup). Did not see a Combos/Family-Meal section if one exists on this location's actual in-app menu -- DoorDash may not expose every category the restaurant has.
